# Vectorial Closure $\vec{W}$

The **vectorial closure** $\vec{W}$ of a language $W \subseteq \Sigma^*$ of finite words is the set of all $\omega$-words $\alpha$ such that infinitely many finite prefixes of $\alpha$ belong to $W$.

Formally:
$$ \alpha \in \vec{W} \iff \text{there exist infinitely many } n \ge 0 \text{ such that } \alpha(0, n) \in W $$

Notice the difference with infinite concatenation $W^\omega$: to be in $W^\omega$, a word must be factorable into infinitely many blocks from $W$. To be in $\vec{W}$, the word itself must have infinitely many prefixes falling into $W$.

For the running editor example, let
$W=\{\texttt{open}\,x\,\texttt{save} :
x\in\{\texttt{edit},\texttt{idle},\texttt{save}\}^*\}$.
Then $\vec{W}$ contains exactly the well-formed infinite editor traces whose
prefixes end immediately after a save infinitely often---equivalently, the
traces in which saving recurs forever.

---

## Widget: Prefix Membership Explorer

Select a preset for $W$ and an ultimately periodic word $\alpha = u \cdot v^\omega$. The widget shows which prefixes of $\alpha$ belong to $W$.

```{=html}
<div class="sc-lab" id="nb13-w1">
  <div class="input-row">
    <div class="input-group" style="flex: 1; min-width: 200px;">
      <label>Preset (W and Word)</label>
      <select id="nb13-preset">
        <option value="0">1. Editor saves recur (Success)</option>
        <option value="1">2. Editor stops saving (Failure)</option>
        <option value="2">3. Even Length Words</option>
        <option value="3">4. Starts and Ends with 'a'</option>
        <option value="4">5. Exact word {ab}</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="input-group">
      <label>Stem (u)</label>
      <input type="text" id="nb13-u" style="width:120px;">
    </div>
    <div class="input-group">
      <label>Period (v)</label>
      <input type="text" id="nb13-v" style="width:120px;">
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
    <h4>Description of $W$</h4>
    <div id="nb13-w-desc" style="font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem;"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="sc-panel">
    <h4>$\alpha(0, 23)$</h4>
    <div class="word-strip" id="nb13-strip"></div>
    
    <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-bottom:16px; align-items:center;">
      <button class="sc-btn" id="nb13-step">Step &#x2192;</button>
      <button class="sc-btn alt" id="nb13-reset">Reset</button>
      <span style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--sc-label);" id="nb13-progress"></span>
    </div>
    
    <div class="prefix-grid" id="nb13-grid"></div>
    <div id="nb13-verdict"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const editorOperations = new Set(['edit', 'idle', 'save']);
  const isSavedEditorPrefix = (arr) =>
    arr.length >= 2 &&
    arr[0] === 'open' &&
    arr.slice(1).every((event) => editorOperations.has(event)) &&
    arr[arr.length - 1] === 'save';

  const PRESETS = [
    {
      desc: "W = { open · x · save | x uses only edit, idle, save }",
      u: "open", v: "edit save",
      isIn: isSavedEditorPrefix
    },
    {
      desc: "W = { open · x · save | x uses only edit, idle, save }",
      u: "open save", v: "edit idle",
      isIn: isSavedEditorPrefix
    },
    {
      desc: "W = { words of even length }",
      u: "a", v: "a b",
      isIn: (arr) => arr.length % 2 === 0
    },
    {
      desc: "W = { words starting and ending with 'a' }",
      u: "", v: "a b",
      isIn: (arr) => arr.length >= 1 && arr[0] === 'a' && arr[arr.length-1] === 'a'
    },
    {
      desc: "W = { 'ab' }  (Example of W^ω vs W-vectorial)",
      u: "", v: "a b",
      isIn: (arr) => arr.length === 2 && arr[0] === 'a' && arr[1] === 'b'
    }
  ];

  const colors = ['#2b9af3', '#f97316', '#22c55e', '#a855f7', '#ec4899', '#eab308', '#0ea5e9', '#ef4444'];
  const symbolColorMap = {};
  let colorIdx = 0;

  function getColor(sym) {
    if (!symbolColorMap[sym]) {
      symbolColorMap[sym] = colors[colorIdx % colors.length];
      colorIdx++;
    }
    return symbolColorMap[sym];
  }

  function parseInput(str) {
    return str.trim().split(/[\s,]+/).filter(s => s.length > 0);
  }

  let stepIdx = 0;
  const maxSteps = 24;
  let wordCache = [];
  let prefixCache = [];

  function loadPreset() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('nb13-preset').value;
    const p = PRESETS[sel];
    document.getElementById('nb13-u').value = p.u;
    document.getElementById('nb13-v').value = p.v;
    document.getElementById('nb13-w-desc').textContent = p.desc;
    resetSim();
  }

  function resetSim() {
    stepIdx = 0;
    
    const u = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb13-u').value);
    const v = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb13-v').value);
    const preset = PRESETS[document.getElementById('nb13-preset').value];
    
    if (v.length === 0) v.push('?');

    // Build the strip
    const stripEl = document.getElementById('nb13-strip');
    stripEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    wordCache = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < maxSteps; i++) {
      const sym = i < u.length ? u[i] : v[(i - u.length) % v.length];
      wordCache.push(sym);
      
      const box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'word-box';
      const charDiv = document.createElement('div');
      charDiv.className = 'word-char';
      charDiv.textContent = sym;
      charDiv.style.background = getColor(sym);
      charDiv.style.opacity = i < u.length ? '0.6' : '1';
      const idxDiv = document.createElement('div');
      idxDiv.className = 'word-index';
      idxDiv.textContent = i;
      
      box.appendChild(charDiv);
      box.appendChild(idxDiv);
      stripEl.appendChild(box);

      if (i === u.length - 1 || (i >= u.length && (i - u.length + 1) % v.length === 0)) {
        if (i < maxSteps - 1) {
          const sep = document.createElement('div');
          sep.className = 'word-separator';
          if (i === u.length - 1) {
            sep.style.background = '#050401';
            sep.style.width = '3px';
          }
          stripEl.appendChild(sep);
        }
      }
    }

    // Precalculate prefixes
    const gridEl = document.getElementById('nb13-grid');
    gridEl.innerHTML = '';
    prefixCache = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= maxSteps; i++) {
      const prefix = wordCache.slice(0, i);
      const inW = preset.isIn(prefix);
      prefixCache.push(inW);
      
      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'prefix-item ' + (inW ? 'prefix-in' : 'prefix-out');
      item.id = 'nb13-pref-' + i;
      
      const text = i === 0 ? 'ε' : prefix.join('');
      item.innerHTML = `<span>&alpha;(0,${i}) = ${text.length > 10 ? text.substring(0,8)+'...' : text}</span> <span>${inW ? '&#x2714;' : '&#x2718;'}</span>`;
      gridEl.appendChild(item);
    }
    
    document.getElementById('nb13-verdict').innerHTML = '';
    updateUI();
  }

  function stepSim() {
    if (stepIdx <= maxSteps) {
      document.getElementById('nb13-pref-' + stepIdx).classList.add('visible');
      stepIdx++;
      updateUI();
    }
  }

  function updateUI() {
    document.getElementById('nb13-progress').textContent = `Prefixes evaluated: ${stepIdx} / ${maxSteps + 1}`;
    
    if (stepIdx > maxSteps) {
      // Show verdict based on period
      const u = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb13-u').value);
      const v = parseInput(document.getElementById('nb13-v').value);
      
      // Look at the period part of the evaluation to see if there's at least one match in the period
      let matchInPeriod = false;
      if (v.length > 0) {
        for (let i = u.length + 1; i <= u.length + v.length; i++) {
          if (i <= maxSteps && prefixCache[i]) {
            matchInPeriod = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      
      const verdictEl = document.getElementById('nb13-verdict');
      if (matchInPeriod) {
        verdictEl.innerHTML = `<div class="verdict-box verdict-pass">
          <strong>&alpha; &isin; <span style="text-decoration: overline;">W</span></strong><br>
          The prefix falls into W at least once per period. Since the period repeats infinitely, there are infinitely many such prefixes!
        </div>`;
      } else {
        verdictEl.innerHTML = `<div class="verdict-box verdict-fail">
          <strong>&alpha; &notin; <span style="text-decoration: overline;">W</span></strong><br>
          After the stem, the prefix never falls into W again within the period. There are only finitely many (or zero) prefixes in W.
        </div>`;
      }
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('nb13-preset').addEventListener('change', loadPreset);
  document.getElementById('nb13-step').addEventListener('click', stepSim);
  document.getElementById('nb13-reset').addEventListener('click', resetSim);
  
  loadPreset();
})();
</script>
```
